# Prashant Yoga Nilayam

> A 1,200 sq ft yoga hall in Velachery, teaching in the tradition of Yogacharya Sri B.K.S. Iyengar.

Website: https://prashantyoganilayam.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 77220 74557

## Contact
- Prashant Yoga Nilayam · Velachery, Chennai · +91 77220 74557 · info@prashantyoganilayam.com

## Key facts
- opened in Velachery 2017
- 1,200 sq ft yoga hall
- 20 years of practice by our teacher

## Facilities
- General classes 1
- General classes 2
- Standing poses
- Inversions
- Forward bends & backbends
- Twists
- Restorative postures
- Study of breathing
- Props provided
- Library
- Changing rooms
- Demonstrations & lectures

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Prashant Yoga Nilayam?
Velachery, Chennai.

### What facilities does Prashant Yoga Nilayam have?
General classes 1, General classes 2, Standing poses, Inversions, Forward bends & backbends, Twists, Restorative postures, Study of breathing, Props provided, Library, Changing rooms, Demonstrations & lectures.

### What should I bring?
Your own yoga sticky-mat if you have one. Props are provided, and the centre has mats for occasional use.

### How should I come to class?
On an empty stomach, in non-restrictive clothes, without heavy perfume or jewellery. Changing rooms are available.

### How do I join Prashant Yoga Nilayam?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 77220 74557.
